resolution.note: report prints cost log-ratio CI, Holm p, n units and bootstrap USD per resolved CI; strict refuses a row without total_cost_usd (test/evals/replay-cost-ci.test.ts)

title: The A/B/C report gives CIs and unit counts for cost and refuses a missing cost
body:
Source: S8 readiness audit 2026-11-19 (lead session); ADR 0021 points 10-11.
Evidence: evals/d23/analysis.ts:72 pairedDifference silently drops units missing cost in one arm; evals/replay/abc.ts:223 prints no unit count for cost; no CI for USD per resolved task. Screen data: log-cost SD 0.43 over 70 units, MDE about 15 percent.
Outcome: --report prints for cost C/A and C/B the paired log-ratio with 95% CI (unit-clustered over reps), Holm-adjusted p, the number of units in the pair, and USD per resolved task with a bootstrap CI; a row without total_cost_usd makes --report --strict fail naming it.
Proof: a report test on fixture rows with one missing cost fails strict naming the row; with full rows it prints the CI and n.
